name: sofatofu
description: Let your agent keep your CRM up to date. Ask it to find contacts, log calls, and update deals in sofatofu. See what changed and why, and undo most changes.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent do the CRM work
interface.longDescription:
sofatofu is a CRM built for work you can delegate. Ask your agent to find a contact, log a call, update a deal, or review your pipeline.

See what changed and why, and undo most changes. Your agent works only in the workspace you choose, with the access your role allows.
capabilities: Find records and review your pipeline
Change deal stages and workspace settings

positive.description: Find a company and its open deals
positive.prompt: Find the company Acme in sofatofu and list its open deals.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches companies for Acme, then searches the deals of that company that are not won or lost. Lists each deal with its stage and value, and says when more deals remain.

positive.prompt: Log a call with Dana Lee from today. We agreed to send the pricing proposal next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the person Dana Lee, searches for a matching call, then creates one call activity linked to her with a reason. Reports the new activity and its change_id.

positive.description: Move a deal to another stage
positive.prompt: Mark the Acme renewal deal as won.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the deal stages, finds the Acme renewal deal, and sets its stage to won with the read_id of that search and a reason. Reports the change.

positive.description: Explain and undo the last change
positive.prompt: What did you change in sofatofu today? Undo the last change.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the changes of the signed-in user since the start of the day and explains them. Checks that the last change can be reversed, reads the records it changed, and reverses it with a reason. Reports the new change.

positive.prompt: Summarize my open pipeline: how many deals are in each stage, and what is their total value?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the deal stages and the workspace currency, searches the deals that are not won or lost, and reports the count and total value of each stage. Says when the result is partial.

negative.description: Paying an invoice is not supported
negative.prompt: Pay my supplier's invoice of $500 today.
Show me the deals in the sofatofu workspace of another company that I am not a member of.

negative.description: A request that is not CRM work
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Berlin for next Tuesday.

publication.release_notes:
### 🔧 Everyday improvements

- Name matching ignores punctuation, so "Acme, Inc." and "Acme Inc" count as the same name in searches and duplicate checks.
- `workspace get` always returns `currency`. It is `null` until an owner sets one.
- Tool descriptions explain that a read_id works for one write, and that custom field keys are field names.
